109:- [Read an eval authoring job](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/read-an-eval-authoring-job.md): Progress and dr
afts for a job started by `cases/generate` or `cases/import`. Poll this after a `202`, then commit the job once its `status` is `c
ompleted`.
110:- [Write a finished authoring job's cases into the suite](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/write-a-finished-aut
horing-jobs-cases-into-the-suite.md): Writes the job's drafts into the suite. A draft carrying unresolved blocking issues or propo
sed additions is **skipped** rather than written, and comes back under `skipped` with a `reviewUrl` for finishing it in the app.
111:- [Get one eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-one-eval-case.md): A case that belongs to this suite
and project. A case in another suite is a 404, not a 403.
112:- [Delete an eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/delete-an-eval-case.md): Removes the case from the sui
te. Past runs that executed it are not affected.
113:- [Update an eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/update-an-eval-case.md): Partial update: omitted field
s are left as they are. Supplying `steps` REPLACES the case's definition rather than merging into it. `matchOptions` and `checks`
accept `null` to clear the case-level override and fall back to the suite's.
114:- [Upload a run artifact](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/upload-a-run-artifact.md): Stores one artifact refer
enced by an ingested run (typically widget HTML too large to send inline) and returns the `storageId` the run's results then refer
ence. This is what `reportEvalResults` in `@mcpjam/sdk` uses for widget evidence.
115:- [Get an upload URL for a run artifact](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-an-upload-url-for-a-run-artifact.
md): Retired. Every request answers `410 Gone` with `code: "FEATURE_NOT_SUPPORTED"` and `details.code: "SDK_UPGRADE_REQUIRED"`. `@
mcpjam/sdk` 8.17.0 and later upload a run artifact by sending its bytes to `POST /projects/{projectId}/eval-ingest/artifacts`, whi
ch returns the `storageId` the run's results…
116:- [Discover authenticated eval ingestion capabilities](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/discover-authenticated-
eval-ingestion-capabilities.md): Discover authenticated eval ingestion capabilities. Uses the SDK reporting transport and the same
tenant/project authorization as eval ingestion. Unsupported capabilities remain absent.
117:- [Persist advisory case-run evaluations](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/persist-advisory-case-run-evaluation
s.md): Persist advisory case-run evaluations. Uses the SDK reporting transport and the same tenant/project authorization as eval i
ngestion. Unsupported capabilities remain absent.
118:- [Ingest a completed eval run in one call](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/ingest-a-completed-eval-run-in-one
-call.md): The whole-run variant: submit a finished run and its iterations in a single request. This is what the SDK reporter uses
by default.
119:- [Mint a model lease for MCPJam-hosted inference](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/mint-a-model-lease-for-mcpj
am-hosted-inference.md): How an SDK eval running OUTSIDE the platform (local dev, CI) uses MCPJam-hosted inference on the organiza
tion's credits, with no provider key of its own. Authenticate like any other `/api/v1` route (typically an `sk_` key).
120:- [Revoke a model lease](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/revoke-a-model-lease.md): Kills this caller's SDK mod
el leases under `runId` in the addressed project, immediately: the proxy fails a revoked lease closed from that moment. Leases als
o expire on their own, so this is for ending a run early (an SDK suite calls it at teardown) rather than something a caller must d
o.
121:- [Close an open ingestion run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/close-an-open-ingestion-run.md): Marks the run
complete and computes its rollups. Until this is called the run stays open in the dashboard.
122:- [Append iterations to an open run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/append-iterations-to-an-open-run.md): App
ends one batch of iteration results to a run opened by `runs/start`.
123:- [Authenticate and record an eval start](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/authenticate-and-record-an-eval-star
t.md): Called by official SDK, CLI and Vitest runners before executing an eval. Requires an organization API key or saved-login be
arer. Records only start metadata, creates no dashboard run, and applies no debit or quota draw. Planned iterations are intent, no
t completed usage. Reuse the runStartId for ret…
124:- [Open a run for incremental ingestion](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/open-a-run-for-incremental-ingestion.
md): Opens a run that iterations are appended to, for a long CI job that reports as it goes. Pair with `runs/iterations` and `runs
/finalize`.
125:- [Get a run's gate waiver](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-a-runs-gate-waiver.md): The waiver in force ov
er this run, or `null`. Available to anyone who can VIEW the run, not only to those who can grant one: a waiver its readers cannot
see is not a visible waiver.
126:- [Waive a run gate](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/waive-a-run-gate.md): Override a FAILING run's release ga
te until an expiry you name. This does NOT make the run pass: the run keeps its `result`, the waiver is a separate audited record,
and every surface that honors it, such as the CLI's `eval gate`, reports the gate as waived, by whom, why, and until when.
127:- [Revoke a gate waiver](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/revoke-a-gate-waiver.md): End a waiver early, putting
the gate back. Requires the manage tier.
128:- [Preview deterministic draft evaluators against stored evidence](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/preview-det
erministic-draft-evaluators-against-stored-evidence.md): Requires suite configuration permission and a terminal run. Reserves a 60
-second deterministic-preview cooldown, independent of judge previews. Supply the returned continuation object with the unchanged
draft to read the next bounded population. Reads at most 100 iterations within a 30-second operat…
130:- [Get the authenticated account](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/get-the-authenticated-account.md): The user be
hind the API key (keys act as their creator, scoped to one organization).
131:- [Read the organization's spend budget](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/read-the-organizations-spend-budget.md)
: The ceiling on what this organization may spend on MCPJam-billed work (chat, evals, judges and computer time) in the current bil
ling window, and how much of it has been spent.
